```{r}
#| code-fold: true

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)
```

Read in stimuli data: 

```{r}
exp_json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(here::here(
  "data",
  "moritz",
  "stimuli",
  "exp2-stimuli.json"
)) %>%
  as_tibble(.)

stimuli_df <- exp_json_data %>%
  select(index, seed, noise, flip, type, data) %>%
  mutate(noise = as.character(noise))

# get the mapping between og index and the index used in exp
stimuli_df %>%
  filter(type == "point") %>%
  mutate(expIndex = 1:nrow(.)) %>%
  select(index, type, expIndex) -> point_map
stimuli_df %>%
  filter(type == "point_arc") %>%
  mutate(expIndex = 1:nrow(.)) %>%
  select(index, type, expIndex) -> pointArc_map
```

Read in participant data: 

```{r}
raw_df <- read_csv(here("data", "part_2", "part2_newpilot.csv")) %>%
  as_tibble(.)

pilot_df <- raw_df %>% filter(responseId != "windowEvents")

# participant-relevant df
# i.e., the part that is relevant for pixelsPerMM and distToScreen
participant_df <- pilot_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(trialId, "chinrest")) %>%
  select(1:5)

# part 1 relevant df
part1_df <- pilot_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(trialId, "block5_test")) %>%
  select(1, 3, 4:5) %>%
  mutate(answer = as.numeric(answer)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = responseId, values_from = answer) %>%
  rename(
    num.ans.x = `location-x`,
    num.ans.y = `location-y`,
    num.resp.x = `slider-x`,
    num.resp.y = `slider-y`
  )

# part 2 relevant df
part2_df <- pilot_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(trialId, "task")) %>%
  select(
    participantId,
    trialOrder,
    trialId,
    responseId,
    answer,
    parameters_taskType,
    parameters_taskIndex
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = responseId, values_from = answer) %>%
  rename(
    type = parameters_taskType,
    ogIndex = parameters_taskIndex,
    px.resp.y = pixelResponse,
    num.resp.y = numericResponse
  ) %>%
  mutate(px.resp.y = as.numeric(px.resp.y), num.resp.y = as.numeric(num.resp.y))
```

```{r}
# now which two trials are we missing here ...?

point_map # 48
# why is this 46 ...???
part2_df %>%
  separate_wider_delim(trialId, "_", names = c("A", "B", "expIndex")) %>%
  select(expIndex, ogIndex) %>%
  mutate(expIndex = as.numeric(expIndex)) %>%
  arrange(expIndex) %>%
  # compare "index" from point_map and "ogIndex" in the new thing
  left_join(point_map)
```
